newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan overnight rates down at 3.25 pct to 4.00pct.
newsitem.headline: Jordan overnight rates down at 3.25 pct to 4.00pct.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Jordanian dinar fell again on Saturday to 3.25-4.00 percent from 4.50-5.50 percent on Thursday as excess cash liquidity pushed rates down, traders said.
"Cash is in abundance," one trader said, adding that first signs were that Saturday's weekly issue of CDs (Certificates of Deposit) released more cash into the market than it absorbed.
Results of the newly-issued and maturing CDs are expected on Sunday.
Saturday's fall means that Jordan's overnight rates have fallen to less than half of average levels just 10 days ago.
The rate often fluctuates wildly and is sensitive to minor adjustments in overnight money supply.
